name: manual_6bd27e
claim: Never track a personal phone number in any repository: reference it through an environment variable or a placeholder. Block it twice, with a commit-time pattern for channel-prefixed and E.164 numbers and with a private_phone entry in the off-repo literal registry for bare digits, and search all tracked files, since the same value can sit in configuration, documentation and scripts.

decisions.notes: A real number sat in public repositories, first through a setup document and later through a script and a configuration file whose restore commit was labelled sanitized. Secret patterns covered keys and tokens only. Earlier history still holds it.

rationale: A real number sat in public repositories, first through a setup document and later through a script and a configuration file whose restore commit was labelled sanitized. Secret patterns covered keys and tokens only. Earlier history still holds it.
